entries.name: CIS OCP4 OSCO Compliance Scan
entries.description: This workflow automates the CIS compliance scan for OpenShift clusters using OSCO, validates security policies, converts the results into YAML, and ingests them into Concert for compliance tracking.

entries.name: CIS RHEL9 OpenSCAP Compliance Scan
entries.description: This workflow automates the CIS compliance scan for RHEL 9 using OpenSCAP, ensuring security compliance based on CIS benchmarks. The scan results are retrieved and uploaded into Concert for analysis.

entries.name: CISO Agentic AI Assessment
entries.description: This workflow initiates an OpenSCAP scan on a RHEL machine, invokes the Compliance API to run additional control checks through the Assessment Agent, and aggregates all results into a unified OSCAL Assessment Result for ingestion into IBM Concert.

entries.name: Db2 Database Compliance Scan
entries.description: Scans an IBM Db2 LUW database against 62 database-level security controls and publishes the OSCAL results to IBM Concert.

entries.name: MSSQL Database Compliance Scan
entries.description: Scans a containerized Microsoft SQL Server instance against 62 database-level security controls and publishes the OSCAL results to IBM Concert.

entries.name: Oracle Database Compliance Scan
entries.description: Scans a containerized Oracle Database instance against 57 database-level security controls and publishes the OSCAL results to IBM Concert.

entries.name: PostgreSQL Container Compliance Scan
entries.description: Scans a containerized PostgreSQL instance against 62 database-level security controls and publishes the OSCAL results to IBM Concert.

entries.name: PostgreSQL Pod Level Compliance Scan
entries.description: Scans a PostgreSQL pod on OpenShift against 62 database-level security controls and publishes the OSCAL results to IBM Concert.

entries.name: Apache Kafka Openshift Compliance Scan
entries.description: Scans Apache Kafka running on OpenShift, evaluates it against the Message Queue Middleware compliance controls and publishes the OSCAL result to IBM Concert.

entries.name: RabbitMQ Openshift Compliance Scan
entries.description: Scans RabbitMQ running on OpenShift, evaluates it against the Message Queue Middleware compliance controls and publishes the OSCAL result to IBM Concert.
